name: Optomize
description: Optometry EMR suite — compose markdown case files in the sidebar, store every follow-up visit as compact ∆-deltas (only changed values like ∆iop:OD=16 are written, the rest resolve from the prior visit) and clone a matched patient's profile with pattern=MR plus history-only deltas. Saves visits into a Bases database.
author: FocusCaseX originals
